modifiers.name: Outbreak
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 10%, but only masses of class 3 zombies spawn

modifiers.name: Rifle
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 25%, but only riflemen and medics can be chosen

modifiers.name: Tier 1
modifiers.desc: Increases XP by 10%. Mostly class 1 and 2 hostiles spawn. Cannot be checked with Outbreak.

modifiers.name: 1 life
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 15%. No revives or reinforcements on death. Requires 3+ players.

modifiers.name: Training
modifiers.desc: Training mode (12 of each class) (XP and bank saving disabled)

modifiers.name: Blizzard
modifiers.desc: reduces movespeed by 0.15, visionrange by 3, impossible to pick ali, and increases energy regen by 0.25. XP gain +15%.

modifiers.name: Sushis
modifiers.desc: Sushis will infect some players - Increases XP gain by 15% + additional XP in case of Victory (be infected before the chapter 3 to unlock the April Fish camo). The Sushi modifier prevents the Rifle and Classical modifiers.

modifiers.name: Classical
modifiers.desc: Disable new UAR MOS. The Classical modifier prevents the Rifle and Sushis modifiers.

modifiers.name: Infested
modifiers.desc: tumors spawn randomly, slowing soldiers and buffing undeads. XP gain +10%.

modifiers.name: Rainy Day
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 10%, the Mayor has installed a powerful missiles launcher turret at the top of his house. Asked about that surprising fact, the Mayor just said: "Yes, this is a missiles turret. The biggest I could find.".

items.name: Auxiliary Generator
items.desc: Utilizes kinetic motion to generate additional power. Increases energy regeneration by 30%.
items.req: Win PMC

items.name: Shield Amplifier
items.desc: Module improving the regeneration of shields. +2 shield /s.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Outbreak

items.name: Floodlights
items.desc: Switch the Floodlights on, draining energy over time.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Tier 1

items.name: Flare Gun
items.desc: Fires a flare at the target point providing vision. Enemies also gain vision from flare.
items.req: Kill 100 undead with rockets in one game (500 with Outbreak), not in Recruit. Killing a friendly unit adds 50 back (250 with Outbreak)

items.name: Motion Sensor
items.desc: Activate the FP-500 integrated Motion Sensor, draining energy over time.
items.req: Win Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Outbreak

items.name: Cluster Rockets
items.desc: Fires a barrage of 6 rockets at the target area, dealing 900 damage per rocket and temporarily stunning the targets. Beeing randomly guided, the cluster rockets can go outside the red indicator circle. Explosions damage allies and items.
items.req: Win Nightmare or Apocalypse, taking 5 hits or fewer and without dying

items.name: Enhanced Weaponry
items.desc: An enhanced weaponry allows to avoid the jams, improves the reload speed and the move speed. Jam immunity. Reload speed +15%. Move speed +0.2.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Outbreak

items.name: Auxiliary Generator
items.desc: Utilizes kinetic motion to create energy to produce additional power. Regenerates 1.25 energy per second.
items.req: Win Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Outbreak

items.name: Reconfigured Energy I
items.desc: Facing the necessity of important amounts of energy, the UT Army has reconfigured the energy system of the Alligator LK19. Energy max + 50. Energy regeneration + 0.5.
items.req: Win Nightmare or Apocalypse

items.name: Reconfigured Energy II
items.req: Win PMC

items.name: Improved Rockets I
items.desc: An enhanced combustion system allows an increased speed for the rockets. Rockets speed +100%.
items.req: Win Hard

items.name: Improved Rockets II
items.req: Win Hard

items.name: Improved Rockets III
items.req: Win Insane

items.name: Improved Rockets IV
items.req: Win Insane

items.name: Improved Rockets V
items.req: Win Nightmare or Apocalypse

items.desc: Switch the Floodlights on, draining energy over time.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with Outbreak

items.name: Predator MK II
items.desc: Move speed + 0.01, energy max +20.
items.req: Win PMC

items.name: Flare Gun
items.desc: Fires a flare at the target point providing vision. Enemies also gain vision from flare.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with 1 life

items.name: Predator MK III
items.desc: Move speed + 0.01, energy max +20, life +20.
items.req: Win Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse

items.name: Auxiliary Shield Generator
items.desc: Shield regeneration +2/s.
items.req: Win Nightmare or Apocalypse

items.name: Predator MK IV
items.desc: Move speed + 0.01, energy max +20, life +60.
items.req: Win Insane, Nightmare or Apocalypse with 1 life

items.name: Strike Walk
items.desc: Lasts 2 seconds. Particularity of the Robot, this is here only a movement modifier, it doesn't give any move order. You should it it moving, and you can change the movement during the Strike.
items.req: See a Predator use Strike Walk 7 times within 20 range in one game

items.name: Focus Fire
items.desc: Increases damage by 20%, range by 1.5  for 10 seconds.
items.req: See a Rifleman use Focus Fire 4 times within 20 range in one game

items.name: Advanced medical visor
items.desc: Provides the auto-SITREP.
items.req: Win Hard, Insane, Nightmare, PMC or Apocalypse, with 10 or more heals

items.name: Visor activated
items.desc: Whether the auto-SITREP visor is switched on (profile checkbox).
